mapper.select: select user_id, count(*) as total_count, min(time_ms) as best_ms, round(avg(time_ms)) as avg_ms from cube_record where create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < #{end} group by user_id
mapper.insert: insert into daily_stat (stat_date, user_id, total_count, best_ms, avg_ms) values (#{statDate}, #{userId}, #{totalCount}, #{bestMs}, #{avgMs}) on duplicate key update total_count = #{totalCount}, best_ms = #{bestMs}, avg_ms = #{avgMs}
